message:
Use these question answers to revise the plan:
Question block: open-questions
- Keep `debug=stdout`?: Drop it; `debug` always goes to syslog
- Should the module intercept SIGINT and SIGTERM?: No handlers; the deadline is the only bound, Other: if the user does ctrl+c and pam is configured for pam_unix or some other module we need to let pam fall into that instead of abandoning all sudo
- Accept `ssh-rsa` (SHA-1) CA signatures?: Reject; support rsa-sha2-256 and rsa-sha2-512 only
- How does this repository relate to the monorepo?: Standalone repo with its own release cadence
- Which platforms must the C module support?: Linux glibc (x86-64, arm64), Linux musl / Alpine, OpenPAM — FreeBSD, macOS
- Anything else that should constrain the port?: No answer yet
